english.title: Made and delivered inaccurate return by end of amendment period regarding tax on offshore income, assets or activities
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were required by a notice under section 8 of the Taxes Management Act 1970 to make and deliver a return for a year of assessment, namely **(..SPECIFY YEAR OF ASSESSMENT..), when, at the end of the amendment period, the return contained an inaccuracy the correction of which would have resulted in an increase in the amount of

(A)_[income tax]_
(B)_[capital gains tax]_
(C)_[income tax and capital gains tax]_

that was chargeable for the year of assessment, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT CHARGEABLE..), on or by reference to offshore income, assets or activities, and the amount of that increase exceeded the threshold amount of **(..SPECIFY THRESHOLD AMOUNT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 106D(1) and 106G of the Taxes Management Act 1970.

english.notes: Under section 106D(2) it is a defence for a person accused of an offence under this section to prove that the person had a reasonable excuse for failing to give the notice required by section 7.
